title: Longest Arithmetic Subsequence of Given Difference
summary: Given an integer array and a difference, find the length of the longest subsequence where the difference between consecutive elements matches the given difference.
statement: Given an integer array and a difference, find the length of the longest subsequence where the difference between consecutive elements matches the given difference. A subsequence is formed by removing some elements from the array while maintaining the original order of the remaining elements.
constraints: The subsequence must preserve input order and every adjacent difference must equal difference.
hints: A subsequence ending at value x can extend the best earlier subsequence ending at x-difference.
Map each ending value to its best length so far.
Set best[x]=best.get(x-difference,0)+1 while scanning left to right.
The scan order enforces subsequence order and the map retains the strongest predecessor.
editorial: The scan order enforces subsequence order and the map retains the strongest predecessor.

tests.explanation: The full array is an arithmetic subsequence of length four.
